spec: Centred stack: 30px outlined pill link, 56-64px two-line headline, 18-20px grey sub under 600px wide, 36-40px button pair. 50-100px gap, then a 1080-1120px real app window starting 470-580px down, cut by the fold, filled with real rows, one small panel breaking its edge.

All left on one 60-96px gutter: two-line 44-64px headline from y 200-275, 16-17px grey sub with a small link right-aligned on its baseline, then a 1250-1320px app window from y~500, cut by the fold, nearly monochrome, fading into the page at its base. No background effect.

Copy stack, then an app window sitting on a 1200-1340px image mat: wallpaper, lifestyle photo or dithered gradient, radius 12-28px, 40-64px of mat around the window, cropped by the fold. The mat supplies colour and scale so the interface can stay quiet.

Centred stack, then a 576-1280px video tile with radius 20-32, a real poster frame and a visible play control, starting ~530px down and cut by the fold. The poster is the brightest object on screen. Optional quote card beside it at 24px gap.

Centred stack on a dark or quiet field, then one 330-380px phone rising from the fold with only its top 170-320px visible, lit from behind by a wide flat horizon glow anchored below the viewport. Dim the phone screen so the headline stays brightest.

Centred stack over a schematic of how the product works: one 75px dark logo tile, 1px elbow connectors to 6-8 small mono caps tags naming real systems, lines fading out by 90% of page width. Faint measured grid behind. No screenshot needed.

Centred copy over the product's real unit instead of an app window: a fan of 170x220 lesson cards stepping up left to right, or a 400px sign-in card over two ~2 degree tilted ghosts, or two 24px-radius entry cards. Each holds one true example. Fade the base into the page.

Centred stack led by one 86-154px live brand object above the headline: a dot matrix meter in a bordered tile, an app icon, an outlined mark. It animates or carries detail, with a fainter field fading outward. Headline, 18-20px sub, button pair, then product peeking at the fold.

Two-line 72-80px centred headline with small real objects set inside the line at x-height: a photo chip, a clock, a calendar slot, a selection box round one word. Objects are 56-64px tall, radius 12-16, and carry product truth. One or two per headline, no more.

Centred headline and CTA over a four-row customer logo wall at ~40% white, with 3-4 product panels for one named customer rising over it from the fold: stat glass, phone map, job list, and a before-and-after metric strip. Proof and product become one object.

Black or solid tile ~690px tall under the nav. Tight centred stack from 60px down: 56px product name, 28px subtitle, 19px grey date, button pair. Product sits at the tile's base, cropped by it, with its own screen as the only light source.

Centred copy in a protected empty middle, surrounded by a scene that bleeds off the edges: thin-line room drawing on a floor band, cropped planets threaded by orbit lines, or mirrored diagonals of 44px tool tiles fading outward. Product breaks the fold at the base.

Centred stack with availability pill and 44px CTA, then a strip of ~460x290px real work tiles, 16px radius, running off both edges and cut by the fold. For studios and template sellers whose work is the product. Tiles must be real, varied and specific.

Left 450-520px: small chip, 56px headline over 3 lines, 18/28 grey body, CTA plus text link. Right: real UI at 13px, 700x500, overlapping a colour band, breaking the container to 16px from the viewport edge. Two stacked cards offset 40px add depth. Colour stays behind, never around.

Left copy at 60-120px gutter, 48-64px headline, optional search or CTA. Right half: a cut-out person or tall photo bleeding off top, right and bottom with no frame, no card. Copy never overlaps the subject. Often one thin arc or line ties image to headline colour.

Two exact 50 percent panels, no gap, no radius, full height under a thin nav. One flat colour sampled from the image in the other. Stack centred in the colour half: small label, 56-72px title, one line, 34px solid block button in the panel's own dark.

Left copy, right a crafted system picture: isometric stack of real parts, hairline ray burst around a 178px icon, grainy stepped blocks, or line art at ~400px tall, bleeding off an edge. Flat ground, no photo. A three-column version puts the object dead centre with copy either side.

No effects. 330-500px copy column beside a 380-576px tall or 676x380 photo, radius 0-3, top-aligned to the headline, deliberately uneven margins. Text 32-50px, 17px body, one link. Reads like a catalogue page. For brands whose objects and restraint do the selling.

Copy column ~730px, right a narrow useful rail instead of art: five dated news rows, a what's-new list, a 400x350 latest-item card, four role links or a setup checklist. 12px mono dates, hairline rows at ~120px pitch. The hero starts working immediately.

Left copy, right phone or tablet at real scale tilted 10-20 degrees with a second object behind tilted the other way, long soft shadow, real balances or screens, bleeding off an edge. Keep to consumer finance and bold colour fields. Never more than two objects.

Copy left, one physical product right, on a calm ground that matches its packaging: raking light across a coloured surface, a flat brand field, or soft floor shadow. Product at 400-600px, overlapping nothing. Tracked caps trust row or ratings at the fold.

Left rail vertically centred: eyebrow, 48-58px headline, pill pair. Right 576-1024px video panel, radius 20-42, real footage, 32px mute and pause controls bottom right. Optional soft floor glow. Panel may bleed off the right. Poster frame must look finished.

Left copy 515-560px; right a real artefact instead of an image: live code with annotations, or a bordered benchmark panel aligned to the headline top with tabs, four labelled bars, exact seconds and a reproducible method note. Between 1px rails. Measured proof is the hero object.

Headline left, sub or CTA right, on one 1080-1316px measure, right block bottom-aligned to the headline's last line. A product panel or bento begins directly under it, 28-64px down, so proof enters the first screen and the head takes only ~300px.

A 1240px frame of 1px lines, radius 16, no fills. Left 620-720px cell holds headline, sub, command or CTA at 40px padding. Right cell holds a diagram, or a statement over a 3x2 grid of 208x175 logo cells. Lines only, so structure reads as engineering.

Left 328-640px copy with pill, 64-72px headline, CTA pair and command box. Right an editor or console starting ~x750 and running off the viewport, 1px border, radius 8-16, optional second window overlapping. The cut says there is more.

Left column: 56/68 headline, body, pill CTA plus text link. Right: staggered three-column mosaic of tall customer cards, 8px radius, each a different real image with logo and link, columns offset 60-100px and bleeding off the right and bottom edges.

Copy on top, then a textured or gradient plate ~70-100% of the container holding a floating app card at real density, beside a 308px rail with a 30px two-tone statement and a plain feature list. Plate crosses the fold. The texture is the only decoration.

Image fills the viewport under an overlaid nav. Lockup anchored bottom-left at 40-96px inset: tag, 56-80px white headline, 16-18px sub, 46-50px pill. Three proof columns or a second action on the same bottom baseline at right. Local veil on the lowest 45% only. Top half stays clean.

Media panel inset 8-32px from the viewport, radius 16-32, height to the fold, nav inside it or on page colour above it. Page colour shows as a frame. Copy at 56-120px inside, 48-72px headline. A 56px round arrow may straddle the base. Modern default for photo-led product brands.

Image full viewport, one title at 15-20vw, line-height 0.8, tracking -0.05em, touching or crossing the margins, bottom-anchored, two lines offset left and right. No veil. Only a tiny 12px nav and one 32px outlined action hung above the second line. For culture, fashion, model launches.

Full-bleed or 700-800px image with copy at left and one real functional card docked bottom-right: 318x190 frosted agent line, 416x128 offer with price, donation widget, 285x165 live stat, or two 474x260 product cards. Card radius 8-20. It proves the claim inside the picture.

Subject and interface share depth: figure rising through a 400px 3px translucent phone outline with a live balance on her chest, or a 360px word behind the roof and in front of sky using a cut-out layer. Needs a clean cut-out and a deliberate overlap.

Image has a composed end instead of a rectangle: fades into page colour at the fold so the portrait has no base, or clips to a 120px bottom radius on a brand field, or a cut-out building sits on paper. Lockup bottom-left, actions bottom-right on one baseline.

Two full-height panels edge to edge at exactly 720px each, or a 480px central photo column with text in the side thirds. Zero gutter. One word or wordmark sits exactly on the seam. Panels can act as a chooser, one link per panel. No headline needed.

Edge-to-edge image ~810px tall. Bottom-left: caps title and short dek in 32px white serif. Bottom-right: a two-column index of 15px rows, active row full white, others ~40% opacity, with a small ring timer. The hero doubles as a table of contents.

Full-bleed image with subject in the right 55%. Copy column left, vertically centred, at 56-140px gutter: 48-64px white headline, 16-18px sub, pill or text link. Shot so the left is naturally dark. Leave the subject unveiled. Also works mirrored with subject left.

Mid-tone image with no central subject, flat 20-35% black overlay or none. Centred 40-85px headline, one 12-17px line, small link. Give it edges: the name spread into the four corners at ~90px, small side labels, or two 12px captions flanking the title. For hospitality, food, interiors.

Solid brand colour covers the left 40% of a video or photo and fades to clear by 55%, or the image fades left into grainy near-black. Copy sits on the solid part with full contrast. More honest than a scrim, and it carries identity. Grain stops banding.

Viewport-filling image with no headline. Text no larger than 30px: a caption bottom-left or a centred title, small nav, nothing else. Only for images strong enough to be the message: portfolios, fashion, architecture. Add a thin scroll cue so it does not look unfinished.

Image held back from the edges by a wide paper margin: 960px plate with caption row below, 75% viewport inset plate, or a 1400px photo starting ~500px down under a ghost wordmark. Copy lives on paper, never on the image, so no scrim is ever needed.

Full-width crafted non-photo image in place of a picture: dithered bitmap landscape, stipple grain dunes, one giant flat-faceted brand ribbon ~1300px wide, or the product blurred huge at 30 degrees. Copy left or centred in its calm zone. Single rule-framed plate 700px tall works well.

Retail slide 550-700px tall with product photo, 48-70px headline, 32-48px button, pill pagination and a thin progress bar, sometimes a 150px next-slide thumbnail. For seasonal merchandising only. First slide must work alone, because most visitors never see the second.

Full-bleed muted film, graded cool or desaturated, 48-56px side margin. Caption block bottom-left: 28-64px heading, max ~440-520px wide, 16-17px body. Single action bottom-right on the same baseline. Bottom-only veil. Pause control required. Poster frame first.

Headline on white, then one row: 3 small icon claims left, 238x54 pill right. Below, a 1200-1280px film card, radius 16, starting ~470px down and cut by the fold, with one pause control. The film lives in a card, so type never fights it and legibility is free.

Product on seamless studio ground or macro, no container: car filling the right 60% on grey, hands setting a dial, an object assembling. Copy sits in empty ground with no overlay. Small pause control. The film cuts between wide and macro, so the product becomes the graphic shape.

Dimmed film with ~30% flat scrim or a slight vignette. Centred 48-96px serif or caps headline, one 14-24px line, small button. Warm lived-in footage rather than empty rooms. Cuts every 3-5 seconds, all shots graded alike so the lockup holds over each.

Fast reel with one fixed brand element: 120px WATCH disc dead centre, giant wordmark at 80% width, or a large letterform mask ~330x580 the footage plays through. Clips cut every ~1 second. For studios and brands whose work is varied and the mark must hold it together.

Film inset 16-24px with paper or white gutters, radius 0-16, under the nav, 1392-1408px wide. One small tracked caption centred, or a 50-100px title bottom-left at ~58px in. The gutter gives the film the feel of a framed print and calms hard cuts.

Abstract footage as atmosphere: horizontal motion blur, liquid metal on black, one inflated material. Dark at the left for type, ~70% of frame near black. 620-900px tall, ending in a hard edge. Left-aligned 72-80px headline, 18px sub. Cheap to loop and always legible.

Film plus changing words: a 24px subtitle line at bottom-left that changes per scene, or a 21px italic pull quote inside a 1px hairline frame, or sentences aligned to window slats. The copy has to be worth reading. Include an audio toggle if there is sound.

Headline as a sentence-long paragraph: 48px weight 300 at 1.15-1.2 leading, 4 lines, first sentence ink, the rest ~60% ink, crossing a ribbon so type takes its hue. 14px live counter above, 44-48px CTA pair below, logo row between hairlines at the fold.

One large flat or soft shape behind centred type, and the type overprints it: 660px stepped brand glyph, 1050px white disc in a blurred colour field, or a floor glow. Headline 100-140px, line-height 0.85-1.05, button pair. No knockout, no shadow. The shape is the only decoration.

One sentence, 48-92px, on paper colour, with a single hand-drawn stroke on one or two words: wobbly underline, ring, 3px accent. Stroke is an SVG path, not a CSS underline. ~160px of clear space above and below. Real tiles or line art rise at the fold.

Headline at one third height, then deliberate emptiness, then a real image or card entering at y 720-840, cut by the fold. Copy sits off-axis or centred at 56-88px. Top two thirds nearly bare, bottom edge rich. Scrolling is the reward. Faint grid may fade between them.

Plain centred stack: optional 11-14px label, two-line 72-128px headline, 13-20px sub, CTA. Works only with a distinctive voice, tight 1.0 leading, balanced lines and ~120px top air. Something must rise at the fold: a line drawing, a ribbon, a card edge.

Left or centred 56-96px headline, 20-24px sub, 46-56px CTA, then a row of proof instead of a picture: four 36px numerals with 12px labels, six overlapped avatars, a star rating, or a two-cell 96px news strip straddling the next section.

Name or claim at 150-450px, weight 500-900, leading 0.74-0.95, tracking to -0.055em, measured and fitted to the full width after fonts load, on a flat field, bottom-anchored. Tiny 11-14px text elsewhere, one real still. Festivals, studios, culture, strong local brands. Never for a product that needs explaining.

Centred mark, 34-40px gap, then one 30-44px sentence, optically above true centre, tiny nav, sometimes a second tiny link row at the base. Nothing else. Requires a real mark and a company already known. For anyone unknown this reads as an unfinished page.

Type inside one contained field: 1160x464 dark panel with a living glyph canvas, 496px aurora band between nav and logos, or a full-viewport flat colour poster with wordmark top and statement bottom-left. The field gives type-only heroes mass without a picture.

No media or eyebrow. Two-line headline left at the gutter, ~120px below the nav, ~70px above the real content: plan grid, case-study meta row, article. The page starts doing its job inside the first screen. For pricing, about and docs pages.

Type used as structure: two 140px caps lines justified between 1px rules with a mark in the gap, words stacked into a stepped pyramid, or a small letter beside a 318px word. Small intro, thumbnail and link below on a strict grid.

No headline size at all. A 19px paragraph or lettered list starting at y~270 under a 40px avatar and 14px name, or 12-16px text top-left at a 10-18px inset. Confidence by refusal. Portfolios, labs and archives only. Line length and tone carry everything.

Two-line 64px claim centred at the optical middle, 36px pill pair 24px below, ~290px empty above, and one row of real customer logos pinned to the fold's bottom edge. Only with logos people recognise. Fake or unknown names collapse it.

Headline ~56px over a tight mosaic of real destinations: two 678x199 photo tiles, then four 337x100 rows, radius 24, gaps 4-8px. Every tile is a link with a two-tone label, product image at right and a chevron. The hero is the navigation. Suits stores and multi-product health.

Centred copy in a protected column. Around it ~10 slightly tilted labels, avatars and chips joined by 1.5px wires with ~20px rounded corners, grey shifting to accent along the path, 6px dots at junctions. Wires never cross text. Draws a real workflow, start to finish.

Two centred rows of ~124px dark tiles, radius 28, 1px ~8% border, each holding one real logo or icon. Centre tiles sharp, outer tiles blurred 2-3px at 12-30% opacity, so rows have no last item. 80px title ~50px below, search field under it.

Centred 220x460 phone over four crops tucked behind each other: inner 288px tall, outer 220px, radius ~28, soft ambient shadow. Height steps give depth with no rotation. Each crop shows a different real outcome. Short centred copy above.

Centred headline with ~12-30 small tiles scattered or orbiting around it: 104-140px photos and task squares, radius 8, each with a 13px caption, shrinking and fading toward the edges. Tiles must never touch the copy column. Motion is slow drift on scroll.

~10 unrotated portrait prints 150x205, no borders, scattered with wide gaps round a centred 30px wordmark, bottom row bleeding off, rising at different scroll rates. Or 3-4 crops ~325px wide staggered with two caps phrases. Photos are the only colour. Spacing must feel placed.

Giant 200px word split in two lines left and right, with 3-4 overlapping 400-530px prints stacked at centre covering the middle letters. The eye completes the word. Black on white, archival images, a small caption and date row at the base.

Centred copy above a 1px grid of ~55px cells on a brand field. A cut-out portrait breaks the grid's top edge, with diagonal bars, a row of circles and one tilted real label overlapping its base. Hard edges, no shadow. Bold but disciplined.

Headline above a rail of 4-6 photos, 384-416px wide, 8-16px gaps, touching or crossing both viewport edges. Square or tall portrait, radius 0-16, one finish across all. The rail drifts sideways. Works for local businesses with good photos.

Brand mascot or characters as the central scene: inked character between product tiles casting light that links them, or a tilted monitor with 3D props and blurred foreground. Requires real commissioned art. Never substitute generated clip art or emoji.

One 576x720 image centred on off-white, ~90px from the top, name above, two-line caption below, six 3px progress dots. Reads as a gallery wall with one thing on it. For portfolios and curated sites whose next image is the interaction.

3-5 cards or product cutouts rotated -8 to +25 degrees around a central object, 150-300px, translucent or flavour-coloured, base fading into the page. Bold consumer only. Keep rotations varied and few, or it turns into a sticker sheet.

Three overlapping ~390x185 organic blob-masked photos, stacked with ~10px gaps, yellow pill labels and dashed hand-drawn arrows linking them. Friendly, for family education. Dated anywhere else; do not use for professional products.

Render ground equals page colour exactly, so there is no frame, only soft contact shadows. Object 60-80% of viewport width, headline above and CTA below on the centre axis. Or figures dissolve into the page through a mask, with a 44px name left and price plus pill right at chest height.

One object at ~460-640px, built from thin plates with a colour gradient across each face, with three 11px mono caps callouts on 1px leaders ending in small square nodes, like a technical plate. Keep it inside its canvas. White or pale wash. No shadow plane.

Panel inset 16-24px, radius 24, ~800px tall: black with one product repeated diagonally through fine contour lines, centred white headline overlapping it, or a 1408px render card cut by the fold under a headline with two small fact columns.

Copy left at x~170, object right at 420-640px, nearly dissolving into the ground: matte black render on black with two lit faces, glowing ribbon of real layouts, or iridescent hardware on grey. One light, one material. No product UI needed above the fold.

Pure black, device rising from bottom centre ~510px wide, back-lit, floor glow in the lower corners falling to black, one saturated element as the only colour. No headline, or a 90px line above. Lighting is the entire design. Needs a genuinely good render.

Edge-to-edge render on a pale ground where the logo is a working object: a factory block on a diagonal belt, messy parts entering, neat boxes leaving, belt bleeding off both sides. Headline in the open top-left. Explains the product as a physical joke.

Object sits between layers of type: ~275x520 can with one word passing behind and one in front, 800px server over a 260px ghost marquee, chrome figure overlapping bio text. Requires real depth ordering. Expressive and brand launches.

A code-drawn figure instead of an asset: ring of 1px triangles with moire, ASCII-shaded head in 6-8px glyphs, point-cloud city, extruded tile logo. No images, few words. Portfolios and technical brands. Must respect reduced motion and render a good still.

Full-viewport WebGL room or scene under the nav, no headline above the fold, things to hover and enter. Slow to load and hard to read, so only for studios and games where exploration is the point. Provide a poster and a skip route.

~450x62 field, radius 8, surface fill, 1px border, 18px placeholder, with a ~176x52 accent button inset 4px inside it. Or a 528x73 capsule, 30% white over imagery, with a nested black pill. ~24-40px under the sub. No secondary action. Real product panel below it.

Centred stack, then a 640-700px composer, 116-172px tall, radius 12-16, real caret in placeholder, footer row with attach, mode select and send. 3-4 icon suggestion pills beneath. The input is the demo. Dark interface peeks at the fold.

Command replaces the button: 55-64px pill or 510x64 field split by hairlines into package-manager select, 13-14px mono command and copy icon. Text link beneath. Terminal or product rises at the fold, with any glow hugging the window on three sides. Developer tools only.

Task bar: ~848x64 white pill or 3 selects, zones split by 1px dividers, 12px bold label over 14px grey value, 48px circle or 90x42 search button. Centred under the nav or on a photo. Booking is the only action. Hospitality, travel, local finders.

Search or a single question is the hero, for sites people come to find something in: 85px band with 24px placeholder, 42-56px pill search with filter chips, two cards with search and date, or a lone 1px underline prompt. No marketing claim.

Under the subhead: two 265x68 SSO pills with brand logo and 16px label, 8px gap, hairline 'or' divider, 50px email field with focus border, 134x50 continue pill, 13px legal line. Signup starts on the homepage. For products with self-serve signup.

White ~320px card on a full-bleed photo: Once or Monthly toggle, four amount chips, 40px button stating the exact outcome. Radius 4-8. Donation or quote begins without a page change. For nonprofits and simple priced services.

Split head: headline left, sub and CTAs right spanning its height. Directly below, a four-tab strip fused to a surface frame that runs past the fold; the active tab shares the frame's fill and gains a 2px accent edge. Tabs swap real panels, auto-advance optional.

Headline left, sub and CTAs on one row, then a 1200-1376px canvas, 356-420px tall or cut by the fold, holding live nodes joined by 1px lines, a dark deploy terminal or a builder at work, over a grainy image ground. The picture is the running product.

Beside or under the CTAs, one small working control: 488x176 tabbed copy-prompt card with a mono prompt, or a 522x50 scenario select joined to Start call with a one-line permissions note. The hero does the thing, in one click, with no signup.

Real components or records instead of a screenshot: two columns of live UI cards bleeding off right and bottom, radius 12, or a 1248x620 dark panel with real filters and rows skewed in perspective, breaking the panel top by ~30px.

Visitor advances the story: 704x468 shuffled card deck with two peeking behind, ~640px before-and-after slider with 4 stat chips, or a phone with pill tabs stepping through four product stages. Page holds still while the content changes.

One strange working instrument fills the hero: a date-scrubbed isometric treemap in 1px lines, an ASCII mascot in a real terminal window, a ring HUD around a live animation. For technical brands with a point of view. Must still work as a still frame.
